note: The command examination table: one row per command, as data. Each row is the smallest program that exercises one command plus what should happen. Read by `time_warp_gates commands` and `time_warp_gates repl`; the rules the rows follow are in the comment block below, which was the Python module's docstring until 22.0.0.
rules: Written in documented syntax. Every invocation comes from docs/LANGUAGE_GUIDE.md or Examples/**, not from whatever the interpreter happens to tolerate.
Observable, or it is not a row. A statement whose whole effect is internal state is written together with the smallest thing that shows the state changed.
`expect` is one of: any | prints:TEXT | draws | error | optional.
`also` names the other commands the same source exercises, so the coverage check sees them as covered rather than leaving them looking untested.
